description: Delete an appointment group by id, canceling every time slot and reservation on it and emailing every signed-up participant, then return the deleted group object. This is permanent: the group and its slots cannot be recovered afterward. Pass cancel_reason to include why in that cancellation email. Find the id with list_appointment_groups, and check list_appointment_group_users or list_appointment_group_groups first if you need to know who will be notified. Requires permission to manage the Scheduler in the group's context.

cancel_reason.description: Message to include in cancellation notifications

name: delete_appointment_group
title: Delete Appointment Group
